The per-program prologue (Q tile load, index setup), causal/`-inf` where-masks, fp32 online-softmax rescale and cube<->vector syncs are therefore paid 1024 times for very little work per program.

Inside the scf.for the excerpt shows memref.copy into a fresh tile followed by linalg.transpose of K, then matmuls, plus a loop-carried tensor<64x128xf32> accumulator with an arith.mulf rescale, and a truncf of the probabilities before the low-order matmul. Each iteration is a chain of small dependent ops separated by copies, consistent with roundtrip latency (not bandwidth) dominating; it also shows the acc rescale/step structure is per-iteration cost that scales with iteration count, not with BLOCK_M.
